title: Hezekiah near death dares to plead his piety and integrity before God
source_text: VI. Neque minus de Dei gratia confidebat, seque vera in Dei oculis justitia praeditum credebat pius Rex Ezechias, quum aeger ac morti proximus, suam inter precandum audet commemorare pietatem & integritatem, apud Esaiam, cap. 38. Obsecro, inquit, Domine, memento quaeso quomodo ambulaverim coram te in veritate, & in corde perfecto; & quod bonum est in oculis tuis fecerim.
pass_a_gloss: Nor did the pious king Hezekiah confide less concerning God’s grace, and believe himself endowed with true righteousness in God’s eyes, when sick and near death he dared in prayer to commemorate his piety and integrity, in Isaiah 38: I beseech you, Lord, remember how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done what is good in your eyes.
pass_b_english: Hezekiah, near death, still confides in grace and dares to recall his sincere walk before God.
